rationale: The Latin anchor *vitium* primarily denotes a fault, defect, or moral weakness rather than a specific criminal act or form of evildoing, aligning more closely with frailty.n.02 (moral weakness). While vice.n.02 covers evildoing broadly, *vitium* in patristic and OE contexts typically refers to inherent moral failing/defect, which frailty.n.02 captures better.
